messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the pagination/retry RFC — thinking about a practical SDK surface for Python/TS/Go. TL;DR: propose 1) page-first Pager API across langs, 2) streaming async iterables opt-in, 3) transport abstraction limited to unary + streaming (no complex shim), 4) retry policy injectable but with sane defaults. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on pager-first. Most apps want a simple for-loop over pages. Keep fetch_all as a thin helper, not the default.

alex: Concern: resume token shape. If we hide transport details, tokens need to be compact and forward-compatible (version byte). Otherwise we'll keep decoding complexity in client.

jasmin: For TS ergonomics we should make async iterable the recommended pattern for streaming results, but expose a .byPage() helper for page boundaries. That maps well to `for await (const page of pager.byPage())` patterns.

ryan: Go idioms: avoid hidden goroutines. Provide a Pager with Next(ctx) (returns page, error) and an Items() iterator on the page. Avoid channel-based blocking APIs unless explicit.

sam: Agree with all. Proposal: token = base64 of `{v:1, cursor:..., meta:...}` (opaque to user). SDKs expose a Token type as string; helpers to inspect only in debugging.

maria: Retry surface: default policy in client config (exponential backoff + jitter, idempotent by default for paginated GETs). Allow per-call overrides, and a RetryHook interface for advanced users to instrument attempts.

alex: Edge-case: streaming transports (server-sent chunking / websocket) — retries are harder. Suggest we treat streaming as best-effort: if stream breaks, surface transparent reconnect only when server provides continuation token; otherwise bubble up error.

jasmin: We should document recommended patterns in the SDK cookbook: "streaming for live updates; pager for stable pagination; use tokens for resume on reconnect." Small snippets will help adoption.

ryan: Migration plan for Go: keep existing Pager but add NextWithOpts(ctx, opts) where opts can override retry/context. Deprecate fetch_all in v2.

sam: Backwards compat: add compat layer that maps old fetch_all to new pager helper with warnings. No breaking change in minor.

maria: Metrics + tracing: expose attempt_count, last_error, and token_age in telemetry. Route to console dashboards.

rfc-bot: RFC link posted: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/2026-01-sdk-pagination-retry (auto) :white_check_mark:

alex: One more API detail: make client-side batch size advisory only. Server can still return fewer items; SDK should not retry just because page is small.

jasmin: Agree. Also add an ergonomic `collectPages(limit)` helper for quick scripts.

sam: OK next steps: I'll draft a small PR that implements Pager stubs in python/ts/go, token shape, and a RetryPolicy interface. + schedule a 30m sync Thurs to lock API. Owners: sam (coord), jasmin (ts), ryan (go), maria (python).

maria: SGTM. I'll prep migration notes and cookbook examples.

ryan: I'll prototype NextWithOpts and token passthrough.

jasmin: I'll sketch TS async iterable examples and byPage helper.

sam: Thanks all — short sync Thurs. :thumbsup:
